gameDescription:
Guide the ninja rabbit through the shadows.
Avoid light at all costs.
Rescue the missing carrot princess of the vegetable kingdom... if you can.
instructions: Use arrow keys or WASD to move.
princessDetected:
The Carrot Princess senses your presence!
A wave of light radiates outward... Run!
caughtInLight: You were caught in the light!
ninjaFailed:
The Carrot Princess remains beyond your reach.
Perhaps some rescues were never meant to be...
levelObjectivesContent:
Navigate through 12 levels of increasing danger.
Reach the green goal cell to advance.
Avoid lit cells or lose a life.
You have 3 lives to complete your mission.
movementControlsContent:
- Arrow Keys: Move in four directions
- WASD Keys: Alternative movement controls
- Click/Tap: Move to an adjacent cell
enemyTypesContent:
- Red Guards (Static): Always light the same cells around them.
- Blue Guards (Rotating): Shine a beam that rotates 90 degrees each turn.
- Yellow Guards (Blinking): Toggle their lights on and off each turn.
- Purple Guards (Patrolling): Move along a path, lighting cells ahead and to the right.
- Green Mirrors: Deflect rotating beams 90 degrees. They cannot be avoided — only predicted.
advancedEnemyTypesContent:
- Orange Chasers: Detect you within a radius. Once alerted, they hunt you using the shortest path — even around walls. They glow bright red when chasing. Escape their detection range and they return home.
- Green Mirrors: Stationary diamond-shaped reflectors. They redirect rotating beams by 90 degrees. A single beam can bounce up to 3 times. Plan your path by predicting where reflected light will land.
gameTipsContent:
- Press V to preview where lights will be next turn.
- Press Space to wait a turn without moving.
- Press Z to undo your last move.
- Press Y to redo an undone move.
- Swipe on mobile to move in that direction.
- Tap an adjacent cell or swipe to move on mobile.
storyText:
In the peaceful Vegetable Kingdom, where carrots, cabbages, and all manner of vegetables lived in harmony, a terrible tragedy has occurred.

The beloved Carrot Princess, daughter of King Carrot III, has mysteriously disappeared from the royal palace.

The kingdom is in chaos. The Vegetable Guards have been placed on high alert, patrolling every corner of the realm with their watchful eyes.

As the kingdom's last hope, you, a skilled ninja rabbit from the shadows, have been called upon for this dangerous mission.

You must infiltrate the heavily guarded areas, avoid detection at all costs, and rescue the missing Carrot Princess.

The fate of the Vegetable Kingdom rests in your paws...

Good luck, Night Ninja!
level1Story:
The outskirts of the Vegetable Kingdom. A quiet garden path lies ahead.
No guards in sight. A good place to practice your stealth.
level2Story:
A watchtower stands at the garden's edge. A lone red guard keeps watch.
Its lantern casts a fixed glow. Stay out of the light.
level3Story:
The vegetable garden is dotted with sentries.
Two red guards patrol the rows of crops. Find a path between their lights.
level4Story:
A rotating searchlight sweeps the garden entrance.
Its beam turns clockwise each turn. Time your moves carefully.
level5Story:
The fortress torches flicker with an eerie rhythm.
A blinking guard's light pulses on and off. Move on the dark turns.
level6Story:
The fortress gate combines fixed lanterns with flickering torches.
Three layers of defense. Stay patient, count the flickers.
level7Story:
An underground passage winds beneath the fortress walls.
A patrolling guard marches the corridor. Predict its path.
level8Story:
The gauntlet. Two patrol guards weave through the darkness.
Their paths interlock like gears. Find the gap between them.
level9Story:
The royal palace. Two routes lie ahead — one short, one long.
The old prisoner's warning echoes: "Not every shortcut is what it seems."
level10Story:
The Hall of Mirrors. Rotating searchlights bounce off crystal surfaces.
The beams reflect and multiply. Watch where the light bends.
They say the Princess can sense any living thing nearby...
level11Story:
The Throne Room. Every type of guard protects this sacred hall.
Static, rotating, blinking, patrolling — all stand between you and the final door.
No one who entered the chamber beyond has returned. Not because of guards...
level12Story:
At last... the Princess Chamber. She must be just beyond that door.
A strange warmth emanates from within. The air itself feels watchful.
You've come too far to stop now. But something tells you... she already knows you're here.
